content.short: Community token on World Chain that rewards verified users for daily claims and referrals.
content.description: DNA Token asks members to register with World ID and a referral code, then claim DNA every day and earn more as they bring in others, moving through five levels from Foragers to Astronauts. Holders can stake, trade NFTs on the GenomeX marketplace and use a dedicated DNA Wallet, all as mini apps in World App. It reports more than 670,000 registered users and runs on World Chain, Base and Robinhood Chain.
content.meta: DNA is a referral-driven community token on World Chain with daily claims, staking, a wallet and the GenomeX NFT market.
